paragraph: The Granville composite registers a cautious tilt at 44/100, serving as today's primary verdict for a restrained market posture despite the absence of an active breadth divergence warning. Internal weakness is heavily concentrated in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY down -3.57%) and deteriorating risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV down -1.67%), which overshadow modest relative strength in transports (IYT/SPY up +0.47%). Macro conditions present a mixed backdrop, as the VIX remains calm at 18.03 within a steep contango structure, though high-yield credit spreads widening to 2.77% and 10-year real yields steady at 2.39% signal lingering macro friction. Meanwhile, neutral broad market performance (RSP/SPY at +0.45%) and stable FX markets (USD/JPY at ¥163.82) suggest an orderly consolidation rather than an aggressive sell-off. Given the severe drag from tech leadership against a muted volatility backdrop, the directional lean for the session is mildly bearish, favoring defensive positioning until semiconductor relative performance stabilizes.
